(Japanese: セレビィ を えた Celebi: Encounter Beyond Time) is the adaptation of the movie of the same name. Like other manga adaptations of the s, the manga first appeared in an issue of CoroCoro. The manga was written by Toshio Tanigami.

==Publications==
The manga adaptation of Celebi: The Voice of the Forest has only ever been published in its original magazine. It has never seen release in a collected volume anywhere in the world.

==Differences between the movie and the manga==
The Iron-Masked Marauder only has a in the manga, while in the movie, he also had a and a .
The Iron-Masked Marauder only has Dark Balls as his main weapon in the manga, while in the movie, he also has a spider-like mecha and jetpack.
Dundee, the Team Rocket trio, Mr. White, , and are absent in the manga.
Only a leads , , and Sam to the Lake of Life, while in the movie, a , , and also assist them.
The wild Pokémon watching from the lake shore as Sam helps heal in the Lake of Life for the first time only occurs in the manga.
A scene where Ash and watch several flying only occurs in the manga.
The scene where Ash and Sam are perched in a tree has them only staring at the sunset, while in the movie, they were watching a group of evolve and fly off as .
The scene where Ash and Sam battle the Iron-Masked Marauder's Sneasel and Scizor only occurs in the movie.
In the manga, the group and only battle the Iron-Masked Marauder's Tyranitar instead of the "twig-monster" created by Celebi as in the movie.
